name: 4th & Heart Original Grass-Fed Ghee (100% Clarified Butter)
whyItWorks: Clarified butter slow-cooked until all water evaporates and all milk solids (casein and whey) and lactose are skimmed and filtered out. Ghee is naturally 100% lactose-free and casein-free, and exceptionally rich in short-chain butyric acid—the primary energy source for healing colonocytes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Melt over hot rice, oatmeal, or vegetables. Safe for individuals with severe lactose intolerance or milk protein sensitivities.
watchOuts: 100% pure butter oil; safe for all IBD dietary stages.
